decisions.statement: The state compared is taken from origin/main in both repos.
A cut owed is answered as a fact rather than as a refusal.
Origin is fetched in both repos before anything is compared.
A last cut with no build-input hash leaves a cut owed.
No cut on record leaves a cut owed.
Nothing here builds or uploads or files anything.
A refusal names each repo origin was already fetched into.

definition: the command saying whether a TestFlight cut is owed or the phones are current
